blocks.text: Former reel and real life partners Vilma Santos and Edgar “Bobot” Mortiz reunited after the Star for All Seasons attended the latter’s “Goin’ Standard: The Repeat” concert. During the show held last Saturday, Oct. 10, Santos took the stage and sang “My Pledge of Love” with the veteran actor-singer. Moments from their reunion were shared by Santos through a series of posts on her social media pages on Sunday, Oct. 11.
